_comment: Operator supplement, merged by scripts/refresh-tool-catalogs.sh and never overwritten by it.
Automated probing only sees what this host can reach. Tools that run on provisioned
instances, across pipes, or on nodes that are offline at refresh time are invisible to it —
list them here so the validator does not reject TTPs that use them.
Keys mirror tool_catalogs.json: nmap_scripts, msf_modules, nuclei_templates, nuclei_tags, binaries.
